skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — convert this blog intro into a 30-second video with visuals and background...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily convert free-form text into shareable videos via AI, with cloud rendering and seamless session management.

- Supports text input and files (up to 500MB) for automatic video generation with visuals and background music.
- Simple onboarding — free token generated if not provided; instant session setup.
- Exports high-quality MP4 videos in about 1–2 minutes via remote GPU nodes.
- Handles uploads, credits, status, and exports with user-friendly commands.
- Robust error handling and status feedback for smooth user experience.
- Ideal for marketers, content creators, and educators seeking quick, camera-free video creation.
